summary: The responsibility keeping your current life intact may be the exact obligation making it impossible to change your direction.
body: The responsibility keeping your current life intact may be the exact obligation making it impossible to change your direction. When Saturn squares the North Node, structural duty can take up enough time, money, or authority that a necessary career move or personal shift keeps getting deferred. Simply carrying a heavier load will not fix a setup that is fundamentally stuck. Put the actual costs on paper, and decide what must be delegated, finished, or renegotiated before duty becomes the only reason nothing else moves.
